subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A place where soldiers are stationed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Barracks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Barracks"** refers to buildings or a group of buildings where soldiers live and are stationed. (सैनिकों के रहने का स्थान)
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers returned to their barracks after the training exercise.
 
 
• **Explanation:** Barracks are specifically designed to provide accommodation for military personnel. (सैनिकों के रहने के लिए विशेष रूप से बनाए गए भवन)
